en.name: Eye-Friendly Font Replacer
en.description: Automatically replaces hard-to-read fonts with your preferred Japanese fonts. Includes a font picker.

ja.name: 目に優しいフォント置換

zh_CN.name: 护眼字体替换
zh_CN.description: 自动将难以阅读的字体替换为所选的日文字体，并支持自行选择字体。

ko.name: 눈이 편한 글꼴 교체
